newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-AWA shares near two year highs.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-AWA shares near two year highs.

text.p: Shares in perennial takeover target, gaming machine manufacturer AWA Ltd, edged towards two year highs on Friday in solid, if unspectacular trade, as traders again mulled the possibility of a takeover bid.
By 1.00 p.m. (0300 GMT), AWA shares were seven cents up at 87 cents on turnover of 4.56 million shares.
On Thursday, the company reported full year net loss narrowed to A$14.26 million from A$22.16 million in 1994/95.
The company also announced the sale of its rural communications, aerospace and traffic division to South Africa's Plessey Corp Ltd for A$25 million

Rumoured previous bidders include Victorian-based gambling operator Tabcorp Holdings Ltd and RG Capital, an investment unit associated with former quiz show king turned entrepreneur Reg Grundy, which increased its stake in the company to 14.95 percent on August 16.
Brokers said with the company realising non-core assets to restructure itself as an entertainment company, a takeover bid was a possibility.
"No one stockbroker in particular is doing the buying but with only the gaming part left, someone will probably have a go at them," said a Sydney-based dealer.
By 1.10 p.m. (0310 GMT), AWA shares remained at 87 cents on turnover of 4.56 milion shares.
